critical_code_review_comments: loop_engine.py _with_budget — clean retry loop: tracks attempt count, emits phase_auto_restart SELF_HEALING event with data.kind, exponential backoff via asyncio.sleep(2**attempt), calls _fail() once after MAX_PHASE_RESTARTS exhaustion with reason containing 'budget'. Unit-test verified both happy retry and final-fail paths.

loop_execute.py — Semaphore(MAX_PARALLEL_GENS=3) correctly bounds fan-out. asyncio.wait_for(PER_FILE_TIMEOUT_S=60) per file ensures one hang can't blow the parent execute budget. _generate_one returns None on per-file failure and the gather pipeline filters None — partial success preserved.

Dashboard.jsx line 103 — sidebarPinned default changed to useState(false). Direct consequence: chatActive-driven sidebar collapse on line 286 (chatActive && !sidebarPinned && !sidebarHovered) now fires immediately on chat focus. Confirmed live: width 220→48px.

Dashboard.jsx lines 231-242 — advisor auto-collapse useEffect now depends ONLY on [chatActive] with advisorAutoRef as a once-per-transition gate. The complementary mousemove listener (lines 243+) sets advisorCollapsed=false on the right-edge hover and the effect no longer reverts it. Confirmed live: hover-expanded width is 295-300px stable across a 900ms gap.

PHASE_TIMEOUTS_S now {plan:60, execute:300, verify:180, scan:180, ship:60, ...} — direct fix for the user's 'Phase execute exceeded 120s budget' report. Combined with MAX_PHASE_RESTARTS=2, worst-case effective budget for execute is 300×3=900s before terminal failure.
